svg.text: Call flow between the bench and the V2X ECU
Unidirectional: the bench is the only transmitter. Nothing returns to it.
Scenario Player
bench node
V2X ECU
receiving node
ADA node
listener
Start-up — inside each node, no traffic on the network
load configuration, validate the scenario file
start the encoder helper process
init · configure · subscribe — each call acknowledged
bind UDP 47100, start the receive thread
Live loop — ten messages per second, the only traffic in Phase 1
compute the position of C at scenario time t
encode to UPER through the helper process
one UDP datagram to port 47100
raw UPER message, 58 bytes nominal
decode · validate · deduplicate · build the object message
one UDP datagram to port 47200
object message as JSON
The bench logs one line per datagram sent; the V2X ECU logs one
JSON line per stage, and both streams are read from the node log.
